verdict.rationale: Better Stack runs several preconfigured background automations. Monitors check URLs every X seconds and automatically open incidents and alert on-call staff. Escalation policies notify the team when an alert goes unacknowledged. The AI SRE claims to automatically produce a GitHub PR with a suggested fix for exceptions and to generate post-mortems. These are fixed, product-defined automations rather than general, user-defined autonomous workflows, and the AI agent is mostly invoked on demand (tagging in Slack, MCP). Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation/workflow builder, documentation that AI agents run on schedules or triggers without being invoked, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
